name: Campingplatz Hager
beschreibung: Campingplatz Hager is located in Langkampfen in the Tiroler Unterinntal, just a few kilometers from the fortress town of Kufstein. The surrounding mountain landscape of the Kaisergebirge and the Brandenberger Alpen shapes the close-to-nature surroundings. The facility's amenities include modern sanitary facilities, spacious pitches with electricity connections, and a common room. A bread roll service and a tavern with regional cuisine round off the services offered. The site impresses with its quiet, well-kept atmosphere. Active holidaymakers can access a dense network of hiking and cycling trails directly from the site. The Campingplatz also appeals to families with its playground and spacious sunbathing lawn.
